$comment: Contract for data/tables/reference_envelopes.csv. Checked by build/src/schema.js.
title: Generic reference envelopes, by property
description: One row per reference material and property: the min/max envelope drawn on Ashby charts for scale only. A property is a row here and a value of schema/vocab/reference-properties.csv, which carries its unit, so a new reference property is data and needs no column and no schema change.

fields.name: Property
fields.description: The property this envelope is of; its unit is declared in the vocabulary.

fields.name: Min
fields.description: Lower envelope, in the property's declared unit.

fields.name: Max
fields.description: Upper envelope, in the property's declared unit.
